title: ChronologySchemas
description: Index of the top-level chronology types (generated; see spec/README.md).

Alignment.description: The start of the unit denoted by ``fields`` (astronomical year) happens at ``at``.
Alignment.title: Alignment

BaseDuration.description: An exact, signed number of base units.
BaseDuration.title: BaseDuration

CalendarAnchor.description: A typed date in a calendar; resolves to the start of the unit at the precision.
CalendarAnchor.title: CalendarAnchor

CalendarDuration.description: Amounts of calendar units, applied by calendar arithmetic (chronology-engine §9).
CalendarDuration.title: CalendarDuration

CalendarRule.description: An RRULE-like rule generalized to any calendar (recurrence §2).
CalendarRule.title: CalendarRule

resolved.description: Resolved moments of every non-local time point, keyed by JSON pointer into the definition.

CorrespondenceDef.description: How time in two dimensions corresponds (time-model §12.1).
CorrespondenceDef.title: CorrespondenceDef

Cycle.description: A parallel cycle such as a week (chronology-engine §3.7).
Cycle.title: Cycle

DefinitionTimePoint.description: A time point inside a calendar definition: may also use a ``local`` anchor (§3.10).
DefinitionTimePoint.title: DefinitionTimePoint

Era.description: A partition of time with its own year numbering (chronology-engine §3.8).
Era.title: Era

Formats.description: Format patterns by precision level id, plus ``intercalary`` overrides (§3.11).
Formats.title: Formats

IntervalRule.description: A fixed interval in base units, independent of calendars.
IntervalRule.title: IntervalRule

numbering_start.description: Number of the first regular child in its parent; ignored for the top level.

LocalAnchor.description: A date in the calendar being defined (astronomical year). Valid only inside definitions.
LocalAnchor.title: LocalAnchor

NamedChild.description: A named slot of a sequence template.
NamedChild.title: NamedChild

Overlay.description: An astronomical cycle that never affects date structure (chronology-engine §3.9).
Overlay.title: Overlay

Rational.description: An exact rational ``num/den``, always normalized: gcd 1 and ``den > 0`` (time-model §2.4).
Rational.title: Rational

Regime.description: A complete calendar structure with its own epoch (chronology-engine §3.3).
Regime.title: Regime

RelativeAnchor.description: A slot of another record plus an offset (which may be negative or zero).
RelativeAnchor.title: RelativeAnchor

Selector.description: Positions inside a period, from the period's child level downward (recurrence §2.3).
Selector.title: Selector

SlotRef.description: A referenceable time slot of a record (time-model §6).
SlotRef.title: SlotRef

SyncPoint.description: ``a`` in dimension A happens at the same time as ``b`` in dimension B.
SyncPoint.title: SyncPoint

TimePoint.description:
An anchor plus precision and the circa flag (time-model §5.1).

The member ``range`` is reserved for explicit uncertainty ranges and rejected in v1.
TimePoint.title: TimePoint

TopPattern.description: Which template each top-level unit (year) uses.
TopPattern.title: TopPattern
